Observed against the live compose stack on desktop (1440px) and 393px mobile: no horizontal scroll; the populated page (backups, the key box, readiness) rendered, and its actions exercised through the API routes it calls.

Observed against the live compose stack on desktop (1440px) and 393px mobile: no horizontal scroll, hardening autosave and its refusal (the last good setting kept) exercised.
